verdict.rationale: DPMA is a public IP-office service that takes user-submitted filings, so a privacy question about whether that data trains AI models fairly applies. The evidence pack has no documented AI-training opt-out or data-use policy. The robots.txt probe only shows the register host blocks crawlers, which is a related control and not a user-facing way to keep one's data out of model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
